signs.title: Celadon City
lines: Celadon City — a city of flowers and greenery.
Visit the Department Store, explore the Game Corner, or challenge the Gym.

signs.title: Celadon Department Store
lines: Browse the counters for battle items, evolution items, Z-Crystals and Mega Stones.

signs.title: Celadon Game Corner
lines: Visit Iris at the counter to buy Casino Tokens.
Tokens belong to your account and cannot be exchanged back for money.

signs.title: Celadon City Pokémon Gym
lines: Leader: Erika. A Gym devoted to Grass-type Pokémon.
